headline: Everglades and Biscayne Guided Tour Reservations
reservation: Entry to Everglades National Park requires a standard pass, but specialized ranger-led boat tours and tram slots at Shark Valley should be booked weeks in advance. Seasonal demand during the dry winter months is high; check the official NPS portal for the latest availability. Coastal accommodations in the Art Deco district often reach capacity during spring events.

days.title: Art Deco and Atlantic Shores

stops.name: Art Deco Historic District
stops.detail: Walk the concentration of 1930s pastel architecture along Ocean Drive and Collins Avenue.

stops.name: South Pointe Park
stops.detail: Observe cruise ships departing the channel from the southern tip of the island.

days.driving: Allow 30 minutes; walking is preferred in the historic core
days.note: Parking in South Beach is limited; utilize public garages on 7th or 13th streets.

days.title: Subtropical Wilderness Exploration

stops.name: Shark Valley Observation Tower
stops.detail: Cycle the 15-mile loop to view alligators and migratory birds in the sawgrass prairies.

stops.name: Fairchild Tropical Botanic Garden
stops.detail: Stroll through rare tropical plant collections and extensive butterfly conservatories.

days.driving: Allow 2–3 hours round trip; conditions vary on Tamiami Trail
days.note: Wildlife viewing is most productive during the dry season from November to April.

days.title: Biscayne Bay and Cultural Roots

stops.name: Vizcaya Museum and Gardens
stops.detail: Tour the Italian Renaissance-style villa and formal gardens overlooking the bay.

stops.name: Wynwood Walls
stops.detail: View the curated outdoor museum of large-scale street art and contemporary murals.

days.driving: Allow 1 hour for local transfers; conditions vary
days.note: Sudden afternoon thunderstorms are common from June through September.

intel.title: Coastal Stationing
intel.text: Public garages in South Beach are more reliable than street spots, which are often residential only. At the Everglades, use designated visitor center lots to ensure protection of native habitat.

intel.title: Wetland Connectivity
intel.text: Cellular reception is reliable in the city but drops significantly once entering the Everglades interior. Carry physical maps for navigation along the Main Park Road and remote keys.

intel.title: Glades Transit
intel.text: Top off tanks in Florida City or Homestead before heading into the national park. There are no refueling stations within the Everglades park boundaries beyond the main entrance corridor.

intel.title: Wildlife Windows
intel.text: Early morning is optimal for birding at Anhinga Trail before the midday heat. During summer, plan indoor museum visits for the mid-afternoon rain window.

intel.title: Waterway Transfers
intel.text: Access to Biscayne National Park's reefs is exclusively by boat from the Dante Fascell Visitor Center. The Metromover provides free elevated transit within the Downtown and Brickell districts.

plan.arrival: Pick up vehicle at MIA and transit to Coral Gables or Miami Beach for provisions and check-in.
plan.vehicle: Standard cars are suitable for most areas; check rental terms for driving on unpaved swamp access roads.
plan.goldenHour: Key Biscayne's Bill Baggs Cape Florida State Park offers views of the historic lighthouse at dusk.
